title: Allahabad HC: NOIDA Is a 'State' Under Article 12, but No Section 80 CPC Notice Is Needed to Sue It
case_name: Omveer and 3 Others v. Parul Tomar and 3 Others
card_summary: A trial court in Gautam Buddh Nagar had refused to register a suit against NOIDA, treating it as a State Government that first needed two months' notice under Section 80(1) CPC. The Allahabad High Court set that order aside. It held NOIDA is a 'State' under Article 12 for fundamental rights purposes, but is not a State Government or the Central Government, so Section 80 notice does not apply before suing it.
card_tip: A suit against NOIDA, GNIDA or similar development authorities need not wait out the two month Section 80 CPC notice period; check only the authority's own statute for a specific notice clause.
